misprints.note: The breathing appears to carry an accent stroke. The proclitic ὡς should have none.

uncertain.note: The print shows 'd ,' with a gap where the full stop should be. The type probably failed to ink, so I wrote 'd.,'.
The ending of the deictic form is hard to read: the accent may sit on the second-last ι. I read it as ἐκεινοιί.
There may be an acute under the rough breathing, or it may be ὡς with a damaged mark. I wrote ὥς as it appears.
The print sets it with almost no space ('δ’αὖ'). I wrote it with the usual space.
The numeral looks like a capital I with serifs. I read it as the digit 1 in this typeface.
